$comment: flow: S8 publication contract items 3-5 as amended by operator ruling 2026-09-26 (engine readers read the local record; three independent facts; unapproved material disclosed, not served); S8 surveillance liveness; §4.3 (absence is never zero) | boundaries: Exporter; Operator | design-review: §9 (readers honor the approved revision; completion and delivery health separately visible) | adjudication: (b)2 (replacement S8 publication contract, after the stale-projection incident); (a)K-A3 | methodology: §5 (canonical vs projected revision) | invariants: P-3; P-4; P-6; RG-U | note: freshness-envelope/2, re-scoped by operator ruling 2026-09-26. The engine never reads research back from any external database, so the envelope no longer describes a projection: /1's projected_revision and mixed_generation are retired (a read of the one local record, in one transaction, has no second copy to lag and cannot mix generations), and its physical-sink map becomes the per-connector export delivery fact. What keeps its meaning stays: which approved revision a read serves, whether newer unapproved material exists, and the three facts
title: Reader freshness envelope
description: Returned with every engine read of a topic's approved material, which is always served from the engine's own record. Scientific completion at a dossier revision, current export delivery, and surveillance currency as of a time are three separate facts: a failed or unknown connector delivery makes export delivery partial or unknown without touching completion, and a dead feed makes currency degraded or unknown without rewriting history. Unknown delivery or currency is reported as unknown, never as delivered/current. Nothing here describes what an external database holds beyond what its connector's receipts establish, and no engine read is served from one.

source_revision.description: The local record's current revision of the topic's publishable material, approved or not.

approved_revision_served.description: The approved revision whose material this read serves, read from the local record. Every read names what it served (P-3).

newer_unapproved_material.description: Newer material exists that is not approved. It is disclosed, never served as accepted evidence (P-5).

export_delivery.description: The per-connector delivery fact, from the exporter's receipts and the connector watermarks - never from reading a connector's store. `no_connectors`: no connector is enabled, so nothing leaves the engine and nothing is pending.

connectors.description: Keyed by connector id, so a connector cannot be reported twice with contradictory statuses.

delivered.description: The highest ordering pair this connector has a delivered receipt for, or null.

allOf.description: Export delivery is complete only if every connector delivered.
No connector enabled means none is listed; any other status is about at least one.

feed_issues.description: Why currency is not current, per feed (Astra 0a review A11: 'overdue' is one reason among several — a feed whose latest attempt failed before its next due time is degraded too, and says so). overdue: no successful observation by its due time; failed_before_due: latest attempt failed, not yet due; never_ran: no observation recorded yet; unparseable_payload: the latest response could not be parsed (never read as zero results); cursor_lost: continuation state lost, coverage since unknown; unknown: telemetry missing.
